role_note: Realizes Performance MIDI (TrackModels) through the operator's own VST3 instruments. It renders what the Performance Engine decided; it composes nothing and chooses no sounds. Sound selection is PR-24's job and per-track instrument routing is PR-22's.

runtime.host_note: pedalboard is the in-process VST3 host. It needs the plugin's inner binary (Contents/x86_64-win/*.vst3); given the bundle folder it reports 'unsupported plugin format', which is why services/music-ai-worker assumed a separate native host was required.

assets.note: Plugins are the operator's own licensed software and never enter the repository, a build context, or a response. Only identity strings and digests leave the worker.

contract.health: GET /health?provider=VST3 -> asset + smokeEvidence exactly as renderRemoteInstrument() in artifacts/api-server/src/lib/musicEngines.ts requires
contract.render: POST /render {contractVersion, provider, trackModel, sampleRate, durationSeconds, parameters} -> 16-bit PCM stereo WAV (base64) at ceil(sampleRate*durationSeconds) frames, with trackModelSha256 and performedMaterialSha256 echoed byte-exactly
contract.auth: Bearer VST3_RENDER_TOKEN on every route; unset token fails closed with 503

attribution: Rendered through the operator's licensed VST3 instrument via pedalboard (Spotify AB, GPL-3.0) running as a separate worker process.
routing_status_note: Available to the API only where an operator has configured PEDALBOARD_VST3_API_URL/TOKEN for a worker whose smoke proof matches its manifest. There is nothing to promote centrally: the asset is the operator's.
